details: Jack, an arborist of 14 years, weaves baskets as a creative, mindful pushback against waste. His workshop invites you to reconnect with nature, embrace imperfection, and practice soft activism—creating gifts from Earth’s gifts. Slow down, explore, and collaborate with nature in a meaningful, hands-on way.
bio:
I’m Jack, a passionate explorer of plants, creativity, storytelling, well-being in the world and part time basket case. With 14 years of experience as an arborist, basket weaving has become a way to bring together my love for plants, my pushback against waste, and my appreciation for creativity and mindfulness. I’m excited to share this craft and its deeper connections with others.

The Workshop
This is an invitation to reconnect—with your hands, with nature, and with the simple act of creation. We’ll explore **soft activism**, countering the capitalist model by creating gifts from the gifts of the Earth. Let's slow down, sit together and create.

This is about exploration, not expectation. There’s no “perfect” material, no right or wrong way to create. You are the creature of your own creation.

This workshop is more than just basket-making. It’s a practice in gratitude, resourcefulness, and perspective-shifting. It’s about embracing imperfection, using what’s available, and working with nature. 

You’ll leave with a fresh perspective one where nature is not something to be consumed, but something to collaborate with.

bio:
I am Dr. Belle Taylor a doctor of acupuncture, spinal energetics practitioner, remedial massage therapist, reiki practitioner and passionate women’s health educator in the Chinese medicine and wellness industry.

Over the past 12 years I have practiced acupuncture across the sea and around the world. Co-facilitated workshops on women’s empowerment, sexuality, healing birth trauma and teaching the ‘Conscious Birth Method’. I am a mother of 3 beautiful wild boys and educated thousands of people from around the world on the benefits of acupuncture, remedial massage, feminine empowerment, natural birth and Chinese medicine.

In my spare time you will find me at conscious dance, Kirtan, meditating or playing with my 3 beautiful boys exploring the gorgeous nature in Gippsland.

I am the co-founder of the Conscious Birth Movement an online birth education course, supporting new mothers to have a positive and empowering birth. Our signature course the Conscious Birth Method simultaneously prepares mothers for a positive empowering birth, whilst also preparing her for the enormous rite of passage and identity transformation that happens when a new family member is born and thus a mother is re-birthing herself.

I am especially passionate about empowering and supporting women during pregnancy and postnatal transformation. Pregnancy, birth and becoming a mother (or a mother again) it is a hugely pivotal right of passage in a woman’s life. When a woman is literally birthing herself as a mother and there are so many choices and changes that are occurring physically, mentally, emotionally and spiritually. I love supporting women through the myriad of transformations happening within her, using a combination of modalities and techniques to best support her individually on her specific journey of becoming.

My treatments are holistic and individualised, using a combination of modalities including acupuncture, spinal energetics, remedial massage, cupping, Chinese herbs (patent formulas), western supplements, nutrition, Chinese dietetics, esoteric acupuncture, reiki, meditation, visualisation and energy techniques to treat the whole patient. Your treatment depends upon what you need in the moment along with working towards your long term health and wellness goals. My patients often say that I have a gentle, calming and nurturing approach to my treatments.

I have a passion for treating all things Women’s Health including menstrual irregularities, PMS, PCOS, as well as providing fertility, pregnancy, natural birth and postpartum support. I also love assisting with stress, emotional issues, sleep problems, digestive issues and providing immune system support as well as treatment for Musculoskeletal issues.

I also love using Classical acupuncture treatment protocols on the eight extraordinary vessels which are conduits of our Yuan Qi, which holds the wisdom of all our ancestors and also the blueprint of our true nature and life’s purpose, these channels can be used for:

Physical, psychological and emotional issues that began in childhood (first 7-8 years of life)
Obsessions about the past and future and anchoring consciousness in the present moment
End of life grief/ regret/ fear emotional processing
In the midst of a major life change that feels overwhelming and difficult
Issues around achieving ones life purpose, self-worth and self-acceptance
I am also trained in Remedial Massage Therapy and Reiki which gives me a unique approach in addressing your musculoskeletal issues with techniques including myofascial stretching, cupping, Gua Sha, trigger point therapy and electro-acupuncture along with shifting any pent up emotional tension that causes pain when stored in the musculoskeletal system.

I can assist with a wide range of musculoskeletal skeletal issues, such as:

Chronic and acute back pain

bio:

 Maya teaches creative writing workshops around Australia and internationally via zoom. 
She lives on the banks of Birrarung and co-creates pilgrimage-based ritual, teaches the somatics of altered state experience, and grows food with her home community in the mountain village of Warburton.

details: A powerful relational meditation practice, Circling invites us into a collective communion with the present moment. A journey of embodied presence, authentic relating, surrender, and loving awareness.
bio: Isabelle Xavier is the Founder of Circling Australia, a Gestalt psychotherapist, and a University lecturer. She is deeply passionate about the role of awareness in transforming psyche, soma, spirit, and society; and has found Circling to be one of the most potent modern transformational practices. We will be creating a gentle ritual container for collective and individual grief to be welcomed, held, expressed and witnessed, possibly around a fire, fostering wholeness and connection.
bio:
As we become more connected to the life within us and around us, and more lovingly supported by our community in that connection, we become more enlivened and capable in our creative responses to life and to what we envision is possible. 

Inspired by, and drawing on, the work of Francis Weller, Joanna Macy, Stephen Jenkinson and others, we will be creating a gentle ritual container for collective and individual grief to be welcomed, held, expressed and witnessed.
   
We invite you to bring all the various feelings that are part of our grief – sorrow, anger, confusion, despair, numbness etc – so that, together, we can include them as part of our wholeness in common-unity, and allow space to meet the generative, and often unexpected, gifts that lie within them.

(Photograph by Eyasu Etsub)
